description: ScrapeBox-style candidate discovery for link building and outreach. Rotates Tor exit nodes (and optionally public HTTP proxies) so the server's datacenter IP never touches the search engine, harvests candidate URLs from multiple engines (DuckDuckGo html, Marginalia), dedupes, triages liveness/barrie
